text:
Lia K: Heads-up — kicking off AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding for v1. Need staging service accounts/roles, legal EULA draft, and product packaging JSON (AMI/container metadata, SKU mapping, trial entitlements). Target: internal preview next Tues. @Sam L can you handle legal? @Kevin H can you provision SA in sandbox?

Kevin H: On it — can do SA + IAM role in dev-sandbox. Which permissions? marketplace publish + S3 read? Need exact ARN pattern.

Arpit P: Packaging JSON format sample in our workspace. Also need to confirm trial length 14 vs 30 days — which should be the default?

Maria G: Confirming container image will live in GCR (us-west1) and ECR (us-west-2). We'll share AMI IDs once the bake finishes. For now put placeholder `ami-PLACEHOLDER`.

Sam L (legal): I can draft EULA + trial terms. Any reseller clause for cloud marketplaces we should include? Also need contact for export control review — @Lia K can you loop in?

Lia K: Yes add reseller clause as optional. Export control: cc @Maria G for any technical data. Deadline: EOD Fri for the legal draft.

Kevin H: IAM perms I'm thinking: `AmazonMarketplaceSeller`, `ec2:DescribeImages`, `s3:GetObject` + `sts:AssumeRole` for publish. I'll create SA named `redwood-marketplace-staging` in dev-sandbox and post creds to vault.

marketplace-bot: deploy-bot: New service account created in dev-sandbox: `redwood-marketplace-staging` (id: sa-98765).

Maria G: Thanks — for packaging, sample JSON is at `gs://redwood-marketplace/staging/packaging-v1.json` (contains sku, pricing model, entitlements). @Arpit P please confirm `trial_days` field is acceptable across clouds.

Arpit P: Quick note: AWS expects `trialDurationDays`, GCP expects `trial_period_days` — I'll add a normalization layer in the upload script so we keep a single internal field `trial_days`.

Sam L (legal): Uploaded EULA draft: https://drive.redwood/legal/marketplace-eula-draft-v1.docx — main areas: data usage, telemetry, liability cap, trial refunds. Please comment inline by Thu.

Lia K: Two blockers to unblock this week: 1) AMI IDs by Monday 10am, 2) tax/contracting contact for Azure offer — @finance-team? Kevin can you route.

Kevin H: Routing to finance now and pinging them in private. Also dropping the role trust policy snippet here for review:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

Arpit P: :thumbsup: I'll update the uploader and add field mapping. I propose we go with a 14-day trial to reduce friction on signups.

Sam L (legal): 14 days is fine from legal POV. I'll add an auto-renew opt-out instruction to the EULA.

Lia K: Perfect. I'll compile a short deliverables board (owners + due dates) and ping for a quick sync tomorrow. Thanks everyone :tada:
